name: Centurion
overview: The centurion, a Roman army officer commanding approximately one hundred soldiers, demonstrates remarkable faith in Jesus' authority, recognizing that a spoken word from Christ is sufficient to heal his servant without Jesus' physical presence. This encounter in Capernaum highlights the centurion's understanding of authority, as he compares his own command over soldiers to Christ's power over sickness. Jesus commends this faith as greater than any He has found in Israel, underscoring the centurion's unique belief in His divine ability.
